raw_context:
Paul Hartmann AG
sells and distributes
medical, hygiene, and healthcare products
globally. Its portfolio features core corporate brands alongside specialized subsidiary manufacturers, spanning wound care, incontinence, infection control, and consumer health lines.
BCC Research
Core Product Brands
MoliCare®:
Incontinence management, absorbent pants, and patient care hygiene products.
Sterillium®:
Antiseptic and skin/hand disinfection (via
Bode Chemie GmbH
, a subsidiary).
DermaPlast®:
First-aid plasters, bandages, and sports care products (DermaPlast Active).
Veroval®:
Diagnostic devices including blood pressure monitors and thermometers.
CombiSet®:
Customized surgical procedure trays and operating theater components.
Zetuvit®:
Specialized absorbent wound dressings.
HARTMANN Career
Subsidiary Manufacturers & Associated Brands
Kneipp®:
Herbal medicines, body care, bath products, and dietary supplements (produced by
Kneipp GmbH
KOB (Karl Otto Braun):
Medical textiles, compression bandages, and B2B support products.
CMC (Consumer Medical Care GmbH):
Private-label cosmetic, baby, and retail hygiene items.
